name: Makin' Waves
japaneseTitle: かいぞくじまを めざせ!
sources: gamepressure N. Sane Makin' Waves page
camera: vehicle (jet ski on semi-open water, chase camera, guide arrow to the exit)
totalSource: F3 map cluster sum; reproduces F3 C1 14 and C2 27; gamepressure 'destroy all 37 crates'
countingRule: F3 cumulative counts include the checkpoint crate (F3 p005R). S1-h (deck crate) and the position of the 3-stack after C1 are inferred so that 14 and 27 both hold
badgeConvention: ttBadges: red 1 / blue 2 / green 3 = time-stop crate seconds in time trial; A = Aku crate in time trial (F3 p005R legend). Drawn icon = normal-mode type. Keys 'question?' / 'wood?' = counted crates whose type is unclear (page fold)

observations: Open water but a single counted loop: crates, fruit lines and the guide arrow lay the route; 14/13/10.
Ramps are the crate-delivery device: crates at landings, in-line pairs and a rising triple needing flips, one crate hidden behind a lip.
Danger shares the crate's lane (cannon lanes, mines, drifting mines); the double mine row by the crystal is crate-free pure steering.
All-box is gentle (F3 intro); the risks are fold-side corner singles, the hidden S2-f and the high third crate of S3-e.
The goal island is visible from the start and the route circles it before entering its cavern.
Time crates total 31 s; TT craft = skipping ramps, telling ridable buoys from bouncing ones, holding the nose down on swells, flips for high time crates.
